purpose: FC-10 / KA-12 registry of every cross-repository document this package cites normatively, pinned by immutable commit SHA. A citation pinned to a branch silently re-targets when the other repository moves, so a statement that was true when written becomes a claim about a document that no longer says it. Verified offline by `npm run check:pins`; verified against the remote by `npm run check:pins -- --verify-remote`.

Read a 404 on this pin as 'no access', not 'pin broken', until the gate learns to tell them apart.
